description: This PHP file contains the definition of the Manufacturer model class for the admin catalog module in OpenCart. It provides methods for managing manufacturer records in the database, including CRUD operations, description management, SEO URLs, store associations, and layout configurations.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Model class for managing manufacturer data in the database, including CRUD operations, descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: addManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a new manufacturer record in the database, including descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, and layouts, then returns the new manufacturer ID.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Updates an existing manufacturer record and related data such as descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the active/inactive status of a manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Deletes a manufacturer record and all related descriptions, store associations, layouts, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves a manufacturer record by ID, including description data for the current language.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalManufacturers
methods.description: Returns the count of manufacturer records matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description record for a manufacturer in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions that match a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all description records for a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all description records for a specific language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a manufacturer with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Deletes all store associations for a manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes manufacturer-store associations by store ID.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves a list of store IDs associated with a manufacturer.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Creates a layout association for a manufacturer, store, and layout.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes manufacturer-layout associations by layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes manufacturer-layout associations by store ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout associations for a manufacturer.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts manufacturer-layout associations with a specific layout ID.
